title: The Palm Beach Casino and Bechet's disappearing act
summary: Moore describes the Cannes summer and Bechet leaving a job secretly.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You also played in Cannes at the Palm Beach Casino?
Yes, that's where I was with Moustache.
And you played quite a bit during the summer. That was a good summer for you in other words, in Paris -- that year.

Yeah, I think I told you the story before about Bechet when he was left out of any job that summer because he was trying to pit one against another in order to raise his price and they all ganged up on Bechet, said, "We won't hire you from Canuck, Belgium to Jean Lepain, from Jean Lepain to the Palm Beach Casino. I couldn't get Bechet with me, because I hated to see this guy with nothing to do for the summer. He did all right. I don't worry about Bechet.
Well, Paris was like his second home, I understand.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
He left that job tout suite and was on his way to Paris by the time we came over the next night. So that's just one of the stories --
So this was Sidney Bechet stepping out on a job, then and just telling you that, hey, don't tell anybody that I'm gone, never reveal it.
Now here I am revealing it. I don't think it's any big --
